description: Elektrownie wiatrowe w Polsce. All 229 wind power generation/storage units in Poland carved by native `fueltype` from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes, ENTSO-E EIC codes and upstream source IDs. Verbatim subset of pl-elektrownie (zero derivation).
